data.name: Cold finger
data.function: Gold-plated copper post extending from the mixing-chamber plate down into the magnetic shields, carrying the sample puck. Gold plating avoids the oxide layer that would add thermal contact resistance; the bolted joint is torqued to specification because at 15 mK the thermal conductance of a joint is dominated by its contact pressure.

physics.summary: Thermal link from the mixing chamber to the sample.

data.tooltip: Copper cold finger carrying the sample puck.
